rules.fix: State the positive claim; retain a negated alternative when it corrects a stated belief.

rules.message: A clause ends with a negated alternative.
rules.fix: Keep the useful claim; retain the alternative only when the reader needs the correction.
Name the action, or explain why the alternative was a real option.

rules.pattern: (?:^|[.!?]\s+|\n)\s*(?:why (?:it|this|that) (?:matters|helps)|why you should care|what (?:changed|this means(?: for you)?|that means|you get)|the (?:bug|takeaway|point|lesson|catch|upshot|real (?:question|point|story))|bottom line|the short version)\s*:|\b(?:(?:which|that) is the (?:part|thing|bit|point|half) (?:i'd|i would) (?:keep|say|add)(?: too)?|(?:that|this) is the (?:other|real|whole|hard) (?:half|part|point|story|thing))\b
rules.message: A label or aside announces significance.
rules.fix: Explain the circumstance and consequence together; deleting only the label is insufficient.

rules.pattern: \b(?:here'?s the (?:thing|deal|kicker|catch|twist)|here'?s why|let'?s (?:dive|dig|jump) (?:in|into)|let'?s (?:be|get) (?:honest|real|clear)|without further ado|buckle up|picture this|spoiler alert|let me explain)\b|\bfull stop\.
\b(?:what do you think|agree|thoughts|am i wrong|what'?s your take)\?|\b(?:drop a comment|comment below|tag someone who|let me know (?:in the comments|what you think))\b
rules.fix: Ask a concrete question with something to answer, or end with the information.
